## samesies v1.0.0

First release. A small C++20 command-line tool that finds duplicate files in a directory.

### Features
- Recursively scan a directory (defaults to the current one)
- Group files by size, then compare content with chunked FNV-1a hashing
- Optional interactive deletion with `-d`: pick which file to remove per duplicate group
- `-h` / `--help` usage message

### Install
Download `samesies-v1.0.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`, verify it with the `.sha256` file, then:

```sh
tar -xzf samesies-v1.0.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
./samesies-v1.0.0-linux-x86_64/samesies --help
```

### Known limitations
- Duplicates are detected with a 64-bit non-cryptographic hash, so collisions are possible in theory.
- All empty files are reported as duplicates of each other.
- The delete prompt does not handle end-of-input (EOF) and will keep re-prompting.
